## What changes?

Describe the smallest useful change and why it belongs in RUMBO Open Lab.

## Evidence

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests/checks.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, customer data, private RUMBO source, or production credentials.
- [ ] I have the right to submit all included material, including AI-assisted/generated material.
- [ ] Every commit intended for acceptance has a DCO `Signed-off-by:` line.
- [ ] This PR does not assume organization membership, deployment authority, production access, or paid resources.

## Boundary

`CONTRIBUTED != REVIEWED != RIGHTS_CLEARED != ACCEPTED != MERGED != DEPLOYED`
